realname.description: Your full name, used in the 'From:' header of outgoing messages.

from_address.description: The primary email address used as 'From:' in sent messages.

use_envelope_from.description: Whether to set the envelope-sender address equal to 'From:' (required by many mail servers to prevent SPF failures).

default_account.description: Name of the default account to use when no explicit account is specified (must match an entry in `accounts`).

record_folder.description: IMAP folder where sent messages are saved (e.g., 'Sent', 'Sent Messages').

header_cache_path.description: Path to the header cache file (improves indexing speed).

message_cache_path.description: Path to the message body cache directory (speeds up mail display).

cache_life.description: How long (in seconds) to keep cached headers valid; 0 = never expire. Increase for IMAP to reduce re-fetching.

editor.description: The external text editor used to compose messages.

enable_pgp.description: Enable PGP/GnuPG support for signing and encrypting messages.

pgp_default_key.description: Default GnuPG key ID (email or fingerprint) to use for signing. Required if `enable_pgp` is true.

pgp_sign_as.description: GnuPG key ID to use for signing (if different from `pgp_default_key`).

pgp_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for cached passphrase in gpg-agent.

enable_sidebar.description: Enable the sidebar (folder list) display (requires +sidebar support in NeoMutt build).

sidebar_width.description: Width (in columns) of the sidebar folder list.

theme.description: Color scheme for NeoMutt UI elements. Each entry defines `target`, foreground (`fg`), background (`bg`), and optional `attrs` (e.g., bold, underline).

macros.description: Key macros to define (list of objects with `where`, `key`, `command`, `desc`).

hostname.description: Default domain name for the local system; leave empty to auto-detect (set only if auto-detection fails).
